headline.zh: 服务启动前，检查对话模板结构

sub.en: templ8c renders canonical message sequences through a Jinja chat template and compares expected role markers, tool wrappers and field names. Check bundled or real tokenizer_config.json templates, or probe what a vLLM / SGLang server actually renders.
sub.zh: templ8c 将标准消息序列交给 Jinja 对话模板渲染，再检查预期角色标记、工具包装符和字段名。可检查内置或真实 tokenizer_config.json 模板，也可探测 vLLM / SGLang 服务器实际渲染的模板。

body.en: Canonical cases include system/user messages, tool calls and multi-turn output.
body.zh: 标准样本包括 system、user、工具调用与多轮输出。

body.en: Each diff includes the field, expected marker, observed text and PASS/FAIL.
body.zh: 每项差异包含字段、预期标记、观察文本和 PASS/FAIL。

body.en: TemplateLoader extracts chat_template from tokenizer_config.json for check_source.
body.zh: TemplateLoader 从 tokenizer_config.json 提取 chat_template，供 check_source 检查。

title.en: Check real templates and live servers
title.zh: 检查真实模板与在线服务

body.en: check --tokenizer-config / --source inspects a real model artifact; check --server vllm|sglang diffs the prompts the server itself renders.
body.zh: check --tokenizer-config / --source 检查真实模型产物；check --server vllm|sglang 对比服务器自身渲染的 prompt。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The example creates a local tokenizer_config.json from the bundled qwen3.8 template, loads it through the actual loader and repeats the check after removing the expected wrapper. No upstream template is downloaded.
note.zh: 示例基于内置 qwen3.8 模板创建本地 tokenizer_config.json，经实际加载器读取，再移除预期包装符重新检查。不下载上游模板。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Bundled reference template loaded through local tokenizer_config JSON and compared before/after a deliberate wrapper removal.

body.en: The example creates a local tokenizer_config.json from the bundled qwen3.8 template, loads it through the actual loader and repeats the check after removing the expected wrapper. No upstream template is downloaded.
body.zh: 示例基于内置 qwen3.8 模板创建本地 tokenizer_config.json，经实际加载器读取，再移除预期包装符重新检查。不下载上游模板。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/templ8c.git
cd templ8c
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .

limitations.en: The comparator primarily checks substring presence. It does not parse all tool JSON semantics or prove template equivalence.
limitations.zh: 比较器主要检查子串是否出现，不解析全部工具 JSON 语义，也不证明模板等价。

limitations.en: Bundled specs and family names are repository fixtures, not verified upstream contracts.
limitations.zh: 内置规范与系列名称是仓库样本，不是已经验证的上游约定。

limitations.en: The server probe goes through each platform's documented /tokenize + /detokenize endpoints and checks the server-rendered template text; it says nothing about live tool-call quality.
limitations.zh: 服务器探测走各平台公开的 /tokenize + /detokenize 端点，检查的是服务器渲染的模板文本，不能说明在线工具调用质量。

body.en: A template change can alter the text surrounding a tool call while leaving the application code unchanged. Keeping message examples and expected markers together makes that structural drift visible in a repeatable local check.
body.zh: 模板改动可能在应用代码未变时改变工具调用周围的文本。把消息样本与预期标记放在一起，可通过可重复本地检查发现结构差异。

body.en: ConformanceSpec owns role markers, tool-call expectations and canonical cases. TemplateLoader reads a bundled template or a selected source. Renderer supplies a Jinja environment; Comparator checks marker/wrapper/name presence, and Checker assembles field-level results.
body.zh: ConformanceSpec 定义角色标记、工具调用要求和标准样本。TemplateLoader 读取内置模板或所选来源，Renderer 提供 Jinja 环境，Comparator 检查标记、包装符和名称是否出现，Checker 汇总字段级结果。

body.zh: ConformanceSpec 定义角色标记、工具调用要求和标准样本。TemplateLoader 读取内置模板或所选来源，Renderer 提供 Jinja 环境，Comparator 检查标记、包装符和名称是否出现，Checker 汇总字段级结果。

body.en: The default check command compares a repository-authored reference with its matching repository spec. To inspect a real model artifact, point the CLI at its actual tokenizer_config.json via --tokenizer-config or --source. A successful bundled check is not verification of an upstream model release.
body.zh: 默认 check 将仓库编写的参考模板与配套规范比较；检查真实模型产物时，用 --tokenizer-config 或 --source 指向其实际 tokenizer_config.json。内置检查成功不代表验证了上游模型版本。

body.en: Specifications live in src/templ8c/reference/specs.py. Template config input accepts a chat_template string or a list of named entries, using the first template in the latter form. Remote helper methods fetch repository defaults rather than pinning an immutable revision; download a chosen revision locally when reproducibility matters. --server vllm|sglang renders each test case through the server's chat template via its /tokenize and /detokenize endpoints; --server-url overrides the default http://localhost:8000.
body.zh: 规范位于 src/templ8c/reference/specs.py。输入接受 chat_template 字符串或命名条目列表，列表形式取第一个模板。远程辅助方法获取仓库默认版本，不固定不可变修订；需要可复现时可先下载指定版本到本地。--server vllm|sglang 经服务器的 /tokenize 与 /detokenize 端点渲染测试消息；--server-url 覆盖默认地址 http://localhost:8000。

body.en: The CLI model IDs select repository-defined families and aliases. Without a source flag, check compares the bundled reference template against its spec; --tokenizer-config and --source point it at a real artifact. Read result.diffs and result.failed_count; update the specification only when you have an authoritative reason to change the expected contract.
body.zh: CLI 模型 ID 选择仓库定义的系列及别名。不带来源参数时，check 比较内置参考模板与配套规范；--tokenizer-config 与 --source 指向真实产物。查看 result.diffs 与 result.failed_count；只有具备权威依据时才修改预期约定。

details.code:
.venv/bin/templ8c check --model qwen3.8
.venv/bin/templ8c check --model qwen3.8 --tokenizer-config tokenizer_config.json
.venv/bin/templ8c check --model qwen3.8 --source hf:zai-org/Qwen3.8
.venv/bin/templ8c check --model qwen3.8 --server vllm
